assertions.action: Stand on a monster spawn, press S then W.
assertions.expect: S moves the character down-screen toward the viewer with UE Y increasing (dY > 0); W moves up-screen with Y decreasing (dY < 0); dX = 0 for both.

assertions.action: Compare fighter height with one ground tile width.
assertions.expect: tile width 224 px = 394.576 cm ~= 2.055 x fighter 192 cm; ground strip 896 px = 1578.304 cm = 4 tiles.

assertions.action: Walk the walkable band; watch the capsule bottom.
assertions.expect: Capsule bottom rests at Z=0 across the band; ground texture is a camera-facing/depth projection, no steps. Floor line (primary reading) at Y=211.38 cm; tile band Y in [70.46, 1127.36] cm.

assertions.action: From monster spawn 3 (px 622,260 -> world 1095.653, 457.99, 0) walk W (-Y) and S (+Y) under the PRIMARY reading (tile top 40, rows from top).
assertions.expect_hypothesis_A: movement blocked near Y=422.76 cm (row 10 boundary); S to Y<=1127.36 cm allowed.
assertions.expect_hypothesis_B: spawn area itself blocked (row 11 = value 0 = wall); walkable only Y in [70.46, 422.76) cm.

assertions.action: Check whether each of the 4 monster + 4 rival spawn points is standable (primary reading, rows from top).
assertions.expect: hypothesis A: exactly 2 of 8 standable (monsters at px y=260,261); hypothesis B: exactly 6 of 8 standable (both y=201 monsters + all rivals).

assertions.action: Walk A/D to the map edges from any walkable cell.
assertions.expect: movement stops at X<0 and X>=1578.304 cm (tile ground ends; x<0 / x>896 px content is backdrop/fog, not floor).

assertions.action: Compare the character's feet with the ground texture at a spawn point.
assertions.expect: if feet meet the ground texture at floor line Y=211.38 cm the primary reading (P, tile top y=40) holds; if the texture is 140.92 cm (80 px) off, the preview-generator reading (Q, tile top y=-40, floor line Y=70.46) holds.

assertions.action: Count standable spawn points per reading/row-order (see walkability_hypotheses[].variants[].spawn_points_standable_of_8).
assertions.expect: 3 of 4 reading x row-order combos put ALL 8 spawn points in value-0 cells (A walkable); only P+top splits them (monsters 2/0, rivals 2). A map where nothing is walkable (B outside P+top) is implausible.

axis_mapping.corollary: scene y-down maps to +Y, NOT -Y: mapping it to -Y would invert the W/S depth keys relative to the camera side and flip which end of the ground band is near the viewer.
decision_evidence: Source/UEMMO/Character/SideViewCameraComponent.h:101-102,158-168 - fixed rig yaw=-90 pitch=-18; yaw -90 => camera forward=(0,-1,0), camera right=+X, spring arm puts the camera on the +Y side looking toward -Y, so larger world Y is nearer the viewer and lower on the ground plane.
Source/UEMMO/Character/PlanarMovement.h:6-7,18-19,41-52 - axis convention X horizontal / Y depth / Z vertical; AxisY 'S positive, W negative'; ComputePlanarVelocity returns FVector(AxisX, AxisY, 0).
Source/UEMMO/PrototypeCharacter.cpp:185-193 - the planar vector is fed to AddMovementInput as a world-space direction, so S drives world +Y.

Source/UEMMO/Character/DNFMCharacterVisualComponent.cpp:39-51,470-476,500-514 - canvas x -> camera Right * Facing, canvas y-down -> -Up (image up = world up); camera basis from the fixed rig (EAxis::Y right, EAxis::Z up); yaw 0 faces right. Screen vertical belongs to Z/Up, depth to Y.
DNFM preview projection canvasY = mapY - mapZ (render_dnf_map_preview.py:56): larger z draws higher on screen => z is up-positive elevation.
axis_mapping.mirror: none for map placement (facing mirror is sprite-only)

ground_band.z_derivation: The tile's 600 px image height is projected depth-face (canvas y), not UE height: the preview projects canvasY = y - z, monsters and interactables sit at z=0 across y=201..261 with no vertical spread, and the walk plane is flat. Walk plane Z = 0 cm; scene z (all 0 in this map) maps to UE Z = s * z. Tile band world Y span [70.46, 1127.36] cm (primary reading); floor line Y = 211.38 cm.
